title: Organelles and Their Jobs
summary: The nucleus, mitochondria, ribosomes, ER, Golgi, lysosomes and plastids: a cell as a busy factory.

cbse.chapter: Earlier NCERT: The Fundamental Unit of Life

objectives: I can describe the function of the main organelles.
I can compare plant and animal cells.
I can relate the number of organelles to a cell's job.
misconceptions: The cell wall controls what enters the cell.
Plant cells don't respire because they photosynthesise.
